title: Model training method, device and electronic device based on federated learning

pse.problem: Inefficiency in model training during federated learning due to complex data encryption processes
pse.solution_function: The method performs denoising on noisy intermediate results, determines a gradient factor based on the denoised result and local label data, adds random noise to the gradient factor, and updates local model parameters using the noised gradient.
pse.solution_structure: Involves first participant with label data, second participant with feature data, and potential third-party role for encryption.
pse.solution_implementation: First participant performs denoising on noisy intermediate results sent by second participant, determines gradient factor based on denoised result and local label data, adds random noise to the gradient factor, and sends the noised gradient to second participant. Second participant uses the noised gradient to update model parameters.
pse.effect: Improved efficiency in model training by omitting complex encryption processes while maintaining consistency with conventional model training process
